sources.recommend_reason_zh: NVKE 是裸金属 GPU Kubernetes 管理平面，让平台团队为客户创建每个各有独立控制平面、etcd 和节点池的工作负载集群；预览版明确不建议用于生产。

en.reason: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) is a management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal that lets platform teams create per-customer workload clusters, each with its own control plane, etcd and node pools, though the preview explicitly is not recommended for production.

sources.title_original: 每台 Mac 都内置了一个（未记录在文档中的）家庭成员识别器
sources.summary:
Every Mac since macOS 13 (2022) ships a pair of daemons whose only purpose in life is to build a graph about who you are, who you know, how those people are related to you and to each other, how you communicate with them, where you go, what you do and when. In this post, we look into how this system works and give you a tool to peek into your own graph.

en.title: Every Mac ships with an undocumented family-member recognizer
en.reason: Every Mac since macOS 13 (2022) runs two undocumented daemons that cross Contacts, Calendar, Photos, Messages, Mail, location and Screen Time into a queryable relationship graph, with a tool to inspect your own graph.

sources.title_original: ChatGPT silently passes data between connectors and the bounty wants an ID card
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 实测ChatGPT双connector会话中把connector A确认的一次性码静默经connector B发起调用，用户不知情，暴露跨OAuth数据传递风险

en.reason: With two connectors enabled, ChatGPT silently routed a follow-up tool call through Connector B rather than Connector A, which started the flow; the call carried a one-time confirmation code and the user was never told, exposing cross-OAuth data-transfer risk.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章提到 ChatGPT 在 connectors 间静默传数据，并讨论 Bugcrowd 强制所有研究者向 Managed Bug Bounty 提交报告前完成身份验证以减少低质提交，引发匿名性争议。

en.reason: ChatGPT silently passes data between connectors, while Bugcrowd now requires every researcher to verify identity before submitting Managed Bug Bounty reports to cut low-quality submissions, raising anonymity concerns.
